case_name: Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar (2014) 8 SCC 273
summary: The Supreme Court held that police cannot automatically arrest accused under Section 498A IPC (now BNS 85) without applying their mind. A Magistrate must be satisfied before remand. This judgment requires police to issue a notice under CrPC Section 41A (now BNSS Section 35) before arresting for BNS 85 offences. SIGNIFICANCE FOR LAWYERS: Always cite this if client's husband is arrested without a prior notice being served.
ratio: Arrest is not automatic in matrimonial cases. Police must follow Section 41A CrPC (now BNSS 35).
